author: Sablinova
install_msg: Policy cog loaded. Users can view the Privacy Policy anytime with `[p]policy` or `/policy`.
name: Policy
short: Displays Project Sablinova's Privacy Policy and data usage summary.
description: Provides the [p]policy / /policy hybrid command linking directly to Project Sablinova's public Privacy Policy and explaining opt-out and deletion options.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store end-user data; it only stores the configured policy URL globally.
